parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender identity or expression, and same-sex acts are legal. Visitors carry home-country documents, and the dossier documents no traveller-facing border, document or facility exclusion; the toilet point is only a recommendation. Negatives: a November 2024 account of harassment and discrimination for visibly trans people in public spaces and government institutions (tier 3, with thin recourse), rising political hostility with threats in 2024–2026, and a dated 2011 census incident. Positives: a Supreme Court ruling on recognition, pride events and a school curriculum, though these are resident-facing and only climate signals. Traveller-specific evidence is thin and there is no trans-specific violence denominator, so I rate toward the middle-high band rather than higher.
